text:
maria: Quick sync 30 planning to flip on catalog v3.1 in APAC+EU during tomorrow's 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Need final agreement on staged hedge, pin exclusions, and immediate rollback signals.
tessa: Ack. Proposing a conservative ramp: 2% for 5m, 10% for 15m, 25% for 20m, then hold for 30m checks before going wider.
kevin: Works for infra. We should exclude any pinned customer routes from hedge and also exclude low-latency priority tier.
maria: Agreed. Fallback ordering we want: prod-stable -> quantized-v2 -> low-mem-fallthrough. Keep an active short drain for retired variants (15m).
sam: Ops note 3 I'll be on-call and will keep a quick rollback playbook ready. Suggest a hard rollback if error rate increases by >0.75% absolute for 3m or if P95 latency regresses >30% for 10m.
deploybot: running preflight...
```nchecks: [manifest-consistency, artifacts-present, quant-profile-match, telemetry-hooked, slot-alloc]
result: manifest-consistency:ok, artifacts-present:ok, quant-profile-match:warning (profile mismatch for eu-gpu-small), telemetry-hooked:ok, slot-alloc:ok
```
deploybot: quant-profile mismatch must be acknowledged. Proceeding will auto-select compatible runtime but may alter latency/cost.
nina: Telemetry3 I can patch a small smoke eval in 1h. If deploy proceeds without fix, enable synthetic smoke set + stricter alerts.
kevin: For pinning semantics: pinned models remain at 100% for pinned routes and will not receive hedge traffic. We'll document exceptions in the runbook.
maria: Release notes blurb draft: "v3.1 catalog enablement in APAC/EU with phased traffic hedge; fallback ladder configured; expected latency variance for quantized path; pins preserved for critical routes."
tessa: Also add a note about cost delta ~+12% expected on APAC GPU class due to kernel differences.
sam: Final rollback thresholds restated: immediate rollback if error rate +0.75% for 3m OR p95 +30% for 10m OR service-level 5xx spike >0.3% for 5m. Soft-pause at p95 +12% to halt progression.
maria: Ops fallback: If APAC region breaches SLO we'll shift new allocations to EU for the duration of incident.
nina: Telemetry hook will be live by 01:30 UTC.
deploybot: Approval requested: set `enable=true` for v3.1-catalog scope=[apac,eu] schedule=1762219200 (02:00 UTC tomorrow). Please acknowledge quant warning if you accept risk.
kevin: Acknowledge quant-profile warning. infra accepts.
tessa: I accept risk; product will monitor.
sam: Ops approves. I'll hold rollback switch at hand.
maria: Approved. I'll update the runbook and ping #releases 20m before start. :rocket:
